from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
script = site / 'transform.py'
verifier = site / 'verify_example.py'
binding = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-referral/item-4-release-binding.json')
report = {'scope': 'Fictional offline rehearsal only', 'prior_receipt': 'TASK-179514396200', 'binding_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binding.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'source_sha256': {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (script, verifier, site / 'verify.py')}, 'cases': {}}
variants = 'style_id,title,color,size,sku,barcode,price\nQA-100,Example Shirt,Blue,M,QA-100-B-M,4006381333931,19.00\n'
images = 'style_id,color,position,url\nQA-100,Blue,1,https://example.com/blue-front.jpg\n'

def run(work, argv):
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *argv], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
    return {'argv': [sys.executable, *argv], 'returncode': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    for name, image_csv in [('clean', images), ('duplicate_image', images + 'QA-100,Blue,2,https://example.com/blue-front.jpg\n')]:
        work = Path(tmp) / name
        work.mkdir()
        for source in (script, verifier, site / 'verify.py'):
            (work / source.name).write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
        (work / 'variants.csv').write_text(variants, encoding='utf-8')
        (work / 'images.csv').write_text(image_csv, encoding='utf-8')
        case = {'variants_csv': variants, 'images_csv': image_csv}
        case['transform'] = run(work, ['transform.py', '--variants', 'variants.csv', '--images', 'images.csv', '--out', 'output.csv'])
        if (work / 'output.csv').is_file():
            case['output_csv'] = (work / 'output.csv').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
            case['verify'] = run(work, ['verify_example.py', 'variants.csv', 'images.csv', 'output.csv'])
        report['cases'][name] = case

output = Path('products/services/catalogue-text-fulfillment/clean-and-duplicate-run.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
